rules.title: Use pnpm only
rules.text: Use pnpm in a pnpm workspace. Do not mix in npm or yarn commands or lockfiles.

rules.title: Frozen installs in CI
rules.text: Install in CI with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile so the lockfile is never rewritten silently.

rules.title: Scope with --filter
rules.text: Scope commands to one package with --filter, for example pnpm --filter <name> test, instead of running the whole workspace.

rules.title: workspace: protocol
rules.text: Reference sibling packages with the workspace: protocol so local versions are always linked.

rules.title: Catalogs for shared versions
rules.text: Pin shared dependency versions once in a catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml and reference them with catalog:.

rules.title: Overrides via catalog
rules.text: Use overrides sparingly and point them at a catalog entry so the version lives in one place.

rules.title: pnpm exec over npx
rules.text: Run local tools with pnpm exec and one-off tools with pnpm dlx, so binaries resolve from the workspace.

rules.title: Declared toolchain
rules.text: Use the Node.js and pnpm versions declared in package.json and do not switch versions with a version manager mid-task.

rules.title: Trusted build scripts
rules.text: Allow dependency lifecycle scripts only for packages you explicitly trust.

rules.title: Rebuild after type changes
rules.text: After changing exported types in a workspace package, rebuild it so dependents see fresh declaration files.
